This lot includes multiple vintage Hemingray-42 glass electrical insulators primarily made in the USA. The insulators feature the classic two-tiered dome shape typical of early to mid-20th-century telegraph and power line insulators. Colors include aqua blue and clear glass finishes. description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

https://www.fedex.com/content/dam/fedex/us-united-states/services/Fees_Shipping_Information.pdf
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.

description:
This comprehensive geological collection is designed for education, display, and hands-on learning. The set features a blue-framed, multi-compartment specimen display case housing an array of small, curated mineral samples. Accompanying the display box is a detailed reference guide titled "Gemstones and Minerals of the World," which provides a color-coded identification chart for easy classification. Scattered in the foreground is an assortment of larger loose specimens, showcasing various geological textures in both rough, natural states and polished, tumbled finishes. This collection is ideal for classroom learning, hobbyist rockhounds, or young geologists exploring earth sciences.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.

PLEASE NOTE: electronics, glass, and other fragile items do not qualify for combined shipping.
Refused/Unclaimed Packages:
If an item is returned as unclaimed or not deliverable, we will contact the customer at the email address listed on their ShopGoodwill.com account to notify them of the return. The customer will then have seven (7) days to pay additional shipping charges for the item to be resent. If we have not received payment within those seven (7) days, the item will be relisted and prior payment will be considered a charitable contribution.

Description:
Add a touch of historic charm to your decor or collection with this genuine Hemingray-42 glass insulator in striking aqua blue. Renowned for their iconic craftsmanship and durability, Hemingray insulators were essential on telephone and telegraph lines in the early-to-mid-20th century. This piece features beautiful embossed branding, a thick glass body, and a delightful beaded rim detail, making it both visually attractive and functional. Whether displayed as a standalone accent, repurposed for creative DIY projects, or included in a larger antique glass collection, this insulator offers lasting appeal and nostalgia. Own a slice of industrial history, manufactured in the USA and sure to impress both collectors and design enthusiasts alike. Buy confidently, knowing this is an authentic vintage piece, ideal for gifting or personal enjoyment.

description:
Enter The Earth / Making Memories
Natural Mineral and Fossil Specimen Collection
Geology Study Lot, Late 20th to Early 21st Century
This comprehensive geological collection features a diverse array of natural mineral specimens, fossils, and hand-carved gemstones. The lot is anchored by a 18-compartment organizer containing various rough stones including rose quartz, amethyst, jasper, and apatite, accompanied by a descriptive insert regarding Coprolite (fossilized dung). Complementing the boxed set are several larger individual display pieces and professional carvings from international sources.
Polished Pyrite sphere with "Made in Peru" label featuring natural vuggy texture
Polished Orthoceras cephalopod fossil specimen in black matrix
Amethyst geode with iridescent gold-tone titanium-treated coating
Four hand-carved stone animal figurines: Kambaba, Picture Jasper (Oregon), and Tigereye (South Africa)
Clear plastic organizer box with approximately 18 varieties of rough and tumbled mineral specimens
Condition:
Very good overall condition. Mineral specimens are in their natural rough or polished states as intended. The pyrite sphere and geode are intact with no structural cracks. The carved animals are housed in original protective plastic cases; cases show minor surface scuffing but remain functional. The main organizer box is complete and latches securely, though the lid shows typical light storage wear.

description:
Orthoceras Fossil Specimen Polished Nautiloid Cephalopod Shell Display
This fossil specimen features two Orthoceras fossils embedded in a dark gray to black matrix rock. Orthoceras is an extinct genus of nautiloid cephalopod characterized by long, tapered, conical shells with visible internal chamber lines. The matrix rock is rough and unpolished on the back and sides, while the fossilized shells on the front are polished to a glossy finish, highlighting their natural details and structure. The piece is in excellent natural condition with no visible repairs, suitable for fossil collectors or natural history displays.

description:
Vintage Calligraphy & Writing Collectible Set
Mixed Media Desk Set with Display Box
Wood, Glass, Metal, and Paper, 11 x 8 x 3 Inches
This comprehensive vintage writing and philatelic collection is housed in a decorative black wooden chest with a patterned interior lid. The set features classical tools for traditional correspondence, including both hand-blown glass and carved wooden dip pens, alongside an ornamental magnifying glass and a curated selection of mid-20th-century American postage stamps. Such sets were characteristic elements of personal stationery desks, appealing to calligraphy practitioners and historical ephemera collectors.
Hand-blown twisted glass dip pen and turned wooden pen handle with internal metal nib holder
11 assorted metal pen nibs in various sizes for calligraphy and fine writing
Vintage-style magnifying glass featuring an ornate, relief-patterned metal handle
6 vintage US postage stamps including 1949 Puerto Rico Inauguration (3c) and Noah Webster (4c) issues
Hinged black wooden box with dedicated storage compartments and a decorative patterned underside lid
Condition:
The wooden box shows light exterior shelf wear and surface dust accumulation. The glass pen is intact with no visible chips to the spiral writing tip; includes a small protective sleeve. The wooden pen handle shows significant surface patina, staining, and finish wear consistent with age. Metal nibs show varying degrees of surface oxidation. Stamps are in used/mixed condition; one Noah Webster stamp has a visible tear and several show adhesive residue or hinging marks. Magnifying glass lens is clear with minor tarnishing to the metal frame.
